task.description: Validate TEST-DESIGNER output. Verify every MUST requirement has a runnable E2E test, no test.skip on MUST tests, fixtures are isolated, tests connect to real backend.

result.summary: Test design validation found critical test isolation violation that violates DIRECTIVE T-2. Multiple tests modify shared fixtures, causing test interference.

issues.description: Multiple tests modify shared fixture instances without per-test isolation. Tests TK-UI-04-E2E-02 and TK-UI-04-E2E-04 both attempt to complete the same task from simpleInstance. If first test succeeds, second test will fail because task is already completed. Violates DIRECTIVE T-2 requirement that 'All fixtures use per-test UUIDs' and 'tests are self-sufficient'.
affected_tests: TK-UI-04-E2E-02: complete button submits form to backend
TK-UI-04-E2E-04: success toast shown after task completion
issues.required_action: Replace beforeAll shared fixtures with beforeEach per-test fixture creation. Create fresh instances for each test to ensure isolation.

issues.description: Tests TK-UI-05-E2E-03 and other action tests also modify shared state (claiming, reassigning tasks). If one test claims a group task, subsequent tests expecting unclaimed group task will fail. All stateful operations must use isolated fixtures.
affected_tests: TK-UI-05-E2E-03: claim button sends POST request
issues.required_action: Refactor all action tests to use per-test fixtures.

Missing: E2E-02 (group tasks), E2E-03 (My Tasks filter), E2E-04 (My Group Tasks filter), E2E-05 (All Tasks filter for operators only). Note: These are MUST requirement test cases, not tests.
issues.required_action: Add missing test cases to cover all clauses in requirement.
